extension.summary: Lean enhancements for Estuary MOD V2
extension.description: A small, non-destructive set of enhancements for skin.estuary.modv2 (Estuary MOD V2), built fresh against the Omega release. Reorders the gear Settings menu so Skin Settings sits above Media sources, and adds a dedicated "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2++" Skin Settings category that is home to our tweaks. The System Info overlay is hidden by default (toggle renamed "Disable System Info overlay"), the top-bar weather icons default to the Outline HD set (resource.images.weathericons.outline-hd), and the clock and navigation wordmark each have a per-item toggle that defaults to the stock look. The category also carries in-tab Apply and Restore buttons. Run after installing or updating skin.estuary.modv2. Apply and Restore are both available — original files are backed up once and never overwritten, and Restore reverts every change cleanly.
extension.news: v1.4.9: Renamed to Estuary MOD V2++ (the display name and the "Tony.7.Bones MOD V2++" Skin Settings category) to match the ++ line. Same add-on id, no functional change. v1.4.8: Home menu reliability fix — (re)deploying our home menu now CLEARS script.skinshortcuts' built cache for skin.estuary.modv2 AND drops the built menu hash in one step, so skinshortcuts always regenerates from OUR trimmed menu (Live TV, Movies/TV shows, Add-ons, Favorites, Weather) on the next boot. Defeats the caching race where a live skin-switch built and cached the stock Estuary menu before our menu deployed, leaving the wrong menu on a fresh box. (v1.4.7: First-boot persistence fix — the look settings (weather in the header, Outline HD icons, plain Power/Settings/Search backgrounds, classic power menu) now write straight to settings.xml on apply, so a freshly-provisioned box shows them on the FIRST boot instead of stock; the boot service also re-applies them if they are ever missing (settings-aware gate). (v1.4.6: Home menu now deploys the exact saved layout verbatim — the six-item trim, Movies/TV shows open POV, TV opens the Guide, the Favorites relabel, and the Movies List / TV Shows List widgets — and self-heals (re-deploys) if a skin update or a build race ever resets it. (v1.4.5: Home menu now reliably trims to six items even when Setup's live skin-switch raced script.skinshortcuts into caching the full stock menu — the service detects the un-trimmed menu and rebuilds it on the next boot. (v1.4.4: the auto-apply service now waits for the Home screen to actually render (not just for the skin to be set) before patching, fixing the occasional blank/unfinished home after a restart. (v1.4.3: new V2+ icon; channel numbers off. v1.4.2: TV opens the Guide, Favourites→Favorites, six home widgets hidden.)
